blocks.description: A living orb that breathes with the data — value drives diameter and glow.
Jeweled series pillars — faceted cap, specular edge, glowing base, staggered rise.
Layered spectrum bands — composition of a whole flowing like a river over time.
Constellation map for networks — glowing nodes, weight-sized, light-arc relationships.
The network heartbeat — concentric sonar rings, pace carries urgency, live total at center.
The number, alive — count-up tabular numerals, jewel delta, sparkline whisper.
The score set in orbit — jewel ring gauge 0-10, the Calculator's face.
Answer option: 52px jewel icon / title + sub copy / chevron grid, 66px min-height, per-answer `--accent`.
9-dimension orb grid (5-col): ring gauge + score + name + status per dimension. The mastery signature.
Interest picker: intro block, selectable interest cards with orb + check states, selected pills, skip action.
Assessment progress HUD: pill bar with location dot + label, animated track fill, and percent readout.
Question block: eyebrow label, title, and a hairline rule. The asking face of any assessment.
260px circular score stage: glowing ring gauge with big number + out-of label. The results hero number.
Audio message with a seeded waveform: circular play button, 24-bar waveform, duration label.

blocks.description: Space chat message list, chat composer (text input + mic + send), and post composer (textarea + schedule + post button).
The Smart Door card — "one brain, many doors." 17px radius, per-door `--door-accent` theming, accent radial glow top-right, 48px icon. The connection mechanic's card.

The Hub's slide-in drawer: backdrop + panel + open-state classes. On mobile the left rail becomes a fixed drawer (translateX(-106%) → 0). Toggle via `.drawer-open` on shell/body. Note: the fuller `.naya-drawer` variant (Ledger file) is a future extraction.
The mobile bottom bar shared across Hub, Ledger, and Spaces: 46px round buttons on a radial dark bar, jewel plus-button, pop-up destination menu. `--jewel` themes the plus.
The room shell: head (kicker + title + lede) + toolbar + status line + body + outlet. Every Hub room composes this; `--room-accent` themes the kicker and LED.
The 56px jewel FAB — fixed bottom-right, `--jewel` (default #ffea00), 18px radius. Mobile-only in the Hub (hidden on desktop).
The feed card — "every event is a card, not a line." Jewel, narrative (16px/1.65), source + time meta, accent edge bar with pulse. `--ac` themes per card (default #9d75ff).
The time-grouped stream: time heads, timeline rows, live dot with pulse, ambient pulse ring. The container the feed renders through.
The compact intel row: type tag + title + summary. `--room-accent` themes the type tag and hover border.
Ledger intel card with identity-color edge bar, jewel glyph, source label, time-ago, hint pill, and flash hook.
The stat ribbon: auto-fit grid, 1px hairline gaps, one stat per cell. The `.unknown` variant renders honest "not yet" states. Also covers the Ledger li-card stat pattern (same grammar).
THE signature block of NayaNET. Header (jewel + kind + title + truth badge), the "in a nutshell" 4-layer answer, expandable jewel layers, provenance footer. Every knowledge surface composes this.
Key/value about rows — the About-tab card from the space detail view.
states: about card with rows; optional description paragraph; no accent styling needed (block uses neutral colors)

Vertical law-pipeline steps: jewel marker + bold rule + explanation. Governance as a readable staircase.

blocks.description: Law card: numbered law with diamond marker, title, and body. Governance made visible, one card per law.
Scorecard: score rows with dimension label, big glowing Cormorant number, and note. The Calculator's output face.
Three-language display (human/AI/machine): the 3-language standard made visible. One tongue per language.
Verdict display: Cormorant voice serif, centered, 24px/600. The judgment, spoken plainly.
Space card with cover art — the grid unit of the Spaces discovery view.

blocks.description: The inline honesty badge: 10px/800/.16em, dashed accent border, pill. `--room-accent` themes it; defaults to magenta. Cheap, everywhere.
Color swatch: 44px bar, 10px radius, 4-layer shadow, hover lift. The palette made touchable.
Truth-state grid: orb + label + explanation per epistemic state. Honesty made visible.
The pull-quote: 22px/700 white text, muted sub-line. The editorial voice for reports, decks, and interstitials.
Presence label: 950 weight, .28em tracking, uppercase. The one-line state of the intelligence.
The three compact single-line lens buttons (Collective/Personal/Activity) — one row, real navigation. Each lens has its own hover glow.
The feed-navigation tab bar: horizontal scroll (scrollbar hidden), per-tab `--tc` theming, popover editor shell. Feed tabs are navigation intent, never storage.
Underline tabs with count badges — active tab gets the accent underline and glow, badges render the accent chip.

Smart Note filter pill: glow pill with label, optional 💜/⭐ mark, ⋯ options button, plus a popover editor (label input + purple-heart/gold-star toggles + Cancel/Save) and a shared context menu (Edit / Set Purple Heart / Set Gold Star / Remove).
dependencies: --tc (per-pill accent, set inline by the builder), --cx-dim (dim text color — defined *outside* this block
